teaser: A ledger closed at midnight, balanced to the cent. A casserole carried next door before anyone asked for it. Life path 8 and an ESFJ meet in the same person, and what is particular to this crossing is how naturally the drive to build something lasting folds into the drive to make sure everyone standing near it is fed and steady. Authority, in this crossing, gets earned less by title than by showing up every time, reliably, with the numbers right and the casserole still warm. The ambition is real. So is the hovering concern for whether anyone noticed the plate left out for them.
